requirements.statement: Payment reminders arrive within five minutes of the selected time.
requirements.reason: The delivery probe and latency measurements support the delivery deadline.
requirements.title: Reminders arrive on time

requirements.statement: A changed or deleted payment does not produce an outdated reminder.
requirements.reason: A reminder contained the previous amount after the payment was updated.
requirements.title: Reminders reflect current payments

requirements.statement: Temporary delivery failures are retried without duplicate reminders.
requirements.reason: The recovery job has not run for the deployed release.
requirements.title: Delivery retries avoid duplicates

requirements.statement: Notification workers can read only the payment data needed for delivery.
requirements.method: Access policy analysis and production probe
requirements.reason: The policy changed after its Requirement Review; a successor review is needed.
requirements.title: Workers access only necessary payment data

requirements.statement: Delivery failures are detected and reported to the operations team.
requirements.method: Monitoring rule and alert delivery job
requirements.reason: The alert delivery job stopped reporting. Its last result does not establish current visibility.
requirements.title: Delivery failures reach the operations team

requirements.statement: Each reminder contains the payment name, current amount and due date.
requirements.reason: Component tests passed for the source used to build the observed artifact; release lineage is verified.
requirements.title: Reminders contain complete payment details

requirements.statement: Notification workers use a restricted delivery credential.
requirements.reason: The tested delivery scope is restricted, but one production instance reports an unrestricted scope.
requirements.title: Workers use restricted delivery credentials

requirements.statement: Operators can pause all reminders during an incident.
requirements.reason: Declares neither review: the intent is specified and no Checks or reviews are owed.
requirements.title: Operators can pause reminders
